title: Main thruster definition
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines a main thruster configuration that can be referenced by ship templates. Physical quantities follow ADR-0008 (value+unit objects). Allowed units are defined in the central units registry (assets/json/schema/units.schema.json).

The thruster name is the directory name under assets/main-thrusters/ — no `id` field is needed.

type.description: Thruster type identifier. Determines fuel consumption, heat, sound, and VFX in M3+.

max_forward_thrust.description: Maximum forward thrust in Newtons (applied along -Z local axis per ADR-0006).

max_backward_thrust.description: Maximum backward/reverse thrust in Newtons (applied along +Z local axis). Typically lower than forward thrust.
